headlineOutcome: The Angular adapter is QUALIFIED for publication with documented limitations. In REAL browsers (Chromium + Firefox) the adapter passes: standalone CSR rendering and interaction (pointer + keyboard), S3 event forwarding (select/change/clear with array-vs-scalar contracts), S4 forms integration (reactive FormControl, FormControlName in a FormGroup, template-driven ngModel) with ZERO initial-write echo and EXACTLY-ONE change per user edit, real focus transitions with focus-loss touched (exactly once), disabled-state + programmatic reconciliation, deferred-init durability, destroy/recreate safety, and full-core import NOT reviving the host collision. SSR/hydration is proven by the existing SSR qualification fixture (server annotated + node reuse + zero hydration diagnostics). No production or core source was changed. WebKit is environmentally unavailable on this build host (recorded as a coverage limitation, never an assumed pass). The documented S4 async provenance limitation is preserved and NOT silently classified resolved.
modificationJustification: packages/angular/vitest.config.ts: added an `exclude` for `packages/angular/tests/csr/**` so the new Playwright-driven CSR qualification suite is not collected by vitest (mirrors the existing exclusion for tests/ssr/**. Strictly necessary to keep the vitest unit gate green after adding a Playwright suite). No production source touched.

qualificationDesign.csrFixture: A standalone Angular application (CsrAppComponent) AOT-compiled by ngc against the BUILT @smilodon/angular package and bundled with esbuild into `.aot-csr/csr-bundle.js`. Bootstrapped entirely CLIENT-SIDE (bare HTML document, no server markup) — the pure-CSR shape contrasting the SSR/hydration fixture. Nine controls exercise: standalone single (#plain), standalone multi with clearControl enabled via [config] (#multi), reactive FormControl (#reactive), FormControlName multi in FormGroup (#formgroup), template-driven ngModel (#template), statically disabled (#disabled), programmatically toggled disabled FormControl (#toggled), deferred items binding (#late), and *ngIf destroy/recreate (#removable).
qualificationDesign.zonelessNote: Angular 21 bootstraps zoneless by default; the fixture drives change detection explicitly (ChangeDetectorRef/ApplicationRef.tick) after async host-state mutations (deferred items, *ngIf recreation, programmatic setValue/toggle) so the [items]/[ngModel]/[disabled] bindings re-evaluate and the adapter's ngOnChanges → applyInputs path runs.
qualificationDesign.liveStateGetters: window.__csrApi.live() returns the AUTHORITATIVE live Angular state (FormControl value/touched/pristine, ngModel value, FormGroup value) so the qualification reads genuine form state rather than a publish-time snapshot. window.__csr holds event counters (which by nature only advance on events).
qualificationDesign.driver: Real Playwright pointer (actionability-checked clicks that pierce shadow roots) and real Playwright keyboard (focus + ArrowDown/Enter). No programmatic container.click() anywhere. Shadow-aware focus walks element.shadowRoot.activeElement down the composed chain.

Q-01.title: Standalone CSR consumer works without SSR
Q-01.evidence: App bootstraps client-side (window.__csrBooted===true, bootError null); all 8+ select hosts render their real <enhanced-select> widget visible; document has NO SSR hydration marker (<!--nghm--> absent); initial models exact (reactive 'b', template 'c', group ['a']); deferred items bound.

Q-02.title: Genuine SSR rendering preserves expected placeholder
Q-02.evidence: Server HTML is hydration-annotated (ngh annotations >=4, <!--nghm--> marker) and serializes exactly 2 <smilodon-angular-select> hosts each containing the empty <enhanced-select> placeholder; no combobox/listbox serialized server-side; core not evaluated server-side.

Q-03.title: Hydration reuses server DOM, no mismatch diagnostics
Q-03.evidence: window.__serverNodesReused===true (node identity preserved); Angular logs 'hydrated 4 component(s) and 9 node(s), 0 component(s) were skipped'; zero NG05xx/hydration/mismatch warnings.

Q-04.title: Chromium + Firefox pointer + keyboard interaction
Q-04.evidence: Pointer: combobox click opens listbox + option click selects (exactly one change, selectedValues ['a']). Keyboard: focus + ArrowDown open + navigate + Enter commits a concrete option. Both engines.

Q-05.title: Selection/clearing/event forwarding preserve S3 contracts
Q-05.evidence: Multi accumulates 2 values (array contract), the REAL clear control (enabled via [config]) clears selection and forwards (clear) with clearCount>=1 and selection emptied to []; forwarded (change) detail carries selectedValues + selectedItems (S3 shape).

Q-06.title: Reactive + template-driven forms preserve S4 contracts
Q-06.evidence: Reactive initial write -> ZERO valueChanges, untouched, pristine. Reactive user edit -> model 'c', exactly ['c'] valueChanges. Template-driven ngModel user edit -> live model 'a'. FormControlName multi -> group value ['a','b'] with >=1 group valueChanges. All read from authoritative live state.

Q-07.title: Actual focus transitions + touched callbacks correct
Q-07.evidence: Shadow-aware composed active element IS the widget combobox. Real focus INTO control (not touched) then REAL focus-loss to an external button -> FormControl.touched===true exactly once, host carries ng-touched.

Q-08.title: Disabled-state + programmatic updates reconciled
Q-08.evidence: Static [disabled]=true -> element _config.enabled===false and combobox input disabled. Programmatic setValue('c') -> live value 'c' with exactly one (the model's own) valueChanges, no programmatic echo. Programmatic enable/disable -> FormControl.disabled toggles AND element _config.enabled reconciles to match.

Q-09.title: Deferred init + component destruction safe
Q-09.evidence: Items bound AFTER init (lateItemsBound) are applied and render options (deferred ngOnChanges path, driven via CD tick). Destroy + recreate via *ngIf keeps app healthy: removedOnce true, recreated widget visible and re-opens; ZERO console/page errors after teardown (late async settles ignored).

Q-10.title: Full-core import cannot revive host collision
Q-10.evidence: Full core is loaded (customElements.get('smilodon-select'|'enhanced-select'|'select-option') all defined) yet each Angular host has tag 'smilodon-angular-select', NO foreign shadow root, non-zero widget geometry, and remains pointer-openable.

Q-11.title: Regression gates + traceability pass
Q-11.evidence: All gates green (see gateResults) — Angular unit 62, Angular SSR 4, AOT consumer PASSED, Angular tsc 0, eslint 0, core unit 1071+1skip, core SSR 10, core tsc 44 pre-existing, traceability 129/129. SSE + CSR Playwright green in chromium + firefox.

multiSelectInitChange.title: Multi selects emit one initial EMPTY change at init (core mode-switch mitigation)
multiSelectInitChange.detail: When a control's selection mode changes from the default single to multi at init, core's updateConfig() calls clear() as a runtime-mitigation, which emits a `change` with empty selectedItems/selectedValues/selectedIndices. This is GENUINE CORE BEHAVIOR in updateConfig()->clear()->_emitChange(), NOT an adapter echo and NOT a #plain issue. It surfaces only on multi controls (#multi, #formgroup); a standalone single select (#plain) emits NO boot change. It is correctly classified PROGRAMMATIC by the adapter's provenance (no write-back into the form model: #formgroup groupChanges===0 at init; #multi has no form binding).

preservedLimitations.title: S4 async (server-backed) provenance limitation
preservedLimitations.status: PRESERVED — NOT fixed, NOT silently classified resolved
preservedLimitations.detail: While a server-backed setSelectedValues() fetch is in flight (pendingProgrammaticApplications > 0), the adapter conservatively classifies ANY change as programmatic, so a genuine user edit made DURING the fetch window is not reported to the form model. This is strictly safer than a false echo and is a documented limitation of the adapter's provenance model (see select.component.ts handleChangeForValueAccessor and provenance.ts).
